capabilities: import .jwpub and RTF-ZIP convention program files as structured notes
generate per-day overview, review and question notes per convention
link scriptures and songs to JW Library and open an offline Bible-verse popup
suggest, extend and correct scripture references and song links while typing
import Meeting Workbook issues as one note per week with update support
disambiguation: Also imports Life-and-Ministry Meeting Workbooks, not only convention programs.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; it runs on desktop and mobile, makes no network requests, and supports eight interface and program languages.
problem: Obsidian has no way to import official JW program files or to turn scriptures, songs and speaker names into working links and wiki links while taking meeting notes.

relations.evidence: pairs well with JW Library Linker
songs shown with a JW Library deep link

requires.name: Bible jwpub file (nwt/nwtsty) for the verse popup

summary: Imports Jehovah's Witnesses convention program files (.jwpub/RTF-ZIP) and Meeting Workbooks into structured, linked Markdown notes.
